name: qvac-megaloc-demo
description: Find where a Paris street photo was taken by comparing it with 10,000 street photos, on your own machine, with MegaLoc through the QVAC SDK. Includes a game mode where you and the model each guess. No cloud, no account; a free Mapillary token is only needed once, to download the street photos.
author: QVAC by Tether
